definitions.gloss: electrification; becoming electrically charged; carrying a charge
definitions.explanation: The state or process of an object accumulating an electric charge. Common in discussions of static electricity, materials science, and everyday annoyances.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{帯電|たいでん}しやすい。
examples.english: Static charge builds up easily in winter.

examples.japanese: {帯電|たいでん}⟦{防止|ぼうし}→防止：14571_boushi⟧⟦スプレー→スプレー：11581_supuree⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{素材|そざい}→素材：09492_sozai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{帯電|たいでん}しにくい⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{静電気|せいでんき}→静電気：18522_seidenki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}き→起きる：00521_okiru⟧にくい。
examples.english: This material doesn't easily hold a charge, so static electricity is unlikely.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{帯|たい}→〜帯：30366_tai⟧ (to wear, carry) + {電|でん} (electricity). The ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ form ({帯電|たいでん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧) means "to become charged." Most commonly encountered in discussions of static electricity in winter or in product descriptions for anti-static items.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {帯電|たいでん}⟦{防止|ぼうし}→防止：14571_boushi⟧: anti-static, static prevention
- {帯電|たいでん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to become charged
- {帯電|たいでん}⟦{量|りょう}→量：03799_ryou⟧: amount of charge
- {帯電|たいでん}しやすい: easily charged

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{静電気|せいでんき}→静電気：18522_seidenki⟧: static electricity
- ⟦{放電|ほうでん}→放電：19289_houden⟧: discharge (releasing stored charge)
- ⟦{充電|じゅうでん}→充電：04427_juuden⟧: charging (a battery)
